title: Amazon plans to expand Prime Air drone deliveries to cities in at least five more US states in the coming months, including suburban Chicago and Atlanta (Matt Day/Bloomberg)
summary: Matt Day / Bloomberg: Amazon plans to expand Prime Air drone deliveries to cities in at least five more US states in the coming months, including suburban Chicago and Atlanta — Amazon.com Inc. plans to expand its drone delivery operation to cities in at least five more US states in the coming months …
